Ruling: batch #152 item 4 · letter 1 (declare `onNavigate` on `ObjectGridComponentProps` and read it — `props.onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate`, the prop first — so the ruled docblock's promise becomes true) · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T03:58Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **1** (fallback 2); the maintainer agreed. Facts, re-verified on today's main: the docblock at `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2222-2248` — shaped by the 2026-08-19 ruling on objectui#5234, six phrases pinned — tells programmatic callers that `onNavigate`'s nine siblings are props on `ObjectGridComponentProps` 「and that is where a caller should prefer to pass this one too」; `onNavigate` is declared on that interface **0** times against **9** for the siblings, and the grid reads only `schema.onNavigate` (`:2252`). A host that follows the published advice passes a function that is never called, with no diagnostic. The authoring side is untouched and stays untouched: the zod arm refuses `onNavigate` by name because a function value cannot survive a serialised document. The spec's react-tier contract declares `onNavigate` as a callback on `ListView` (`react-blocks.ts:321`), and `ListView.tsx:2483` threads it the same schema-only way.

## Ruling — **1**

- `ObjectGridComponentProps` declares `onNavigate?: (recordId, action: 'view' | 'edit') => void`; `ObjectGrid` passes `props.onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate` to `useNavigationOverlay` — **the prop wins** when both are present (the programmatic caller is the nearer party; ruled here so no further 「which wins」 ruling is needed). The docblock's sentence stays true as written; its pins are updated only where the read line changes.
- Pins: the prop is called on a row click in `page` navigation mode (new, red on the current head); `schema.onNavigate` alone still works (control); the zod arm still refuses `onNavigate` by name (control, already in `gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`).
- A published React prop widens on `@object-ui/plugin-grid` ⇒ `Clause-②: yes` in the changeset (minor); under batch #151 item 3 the at-tier contract review is owed in the spec and skills lanes only, and this is `domain:ui` — the lane's own review and the gates are the bar.
- ⛔ **2** — removes a promise the ruling itself made and touches six pinned phrases for it; ⛔ **3** — 1 already fixes precedence.

Four-facet reading: ① a React host embedding the grid gets the navigation callback the nine siblings already offer; ② consistent with the siblings and with the spec's react tier; ③ a host's AI following the docblock no longer gets a silent no-op; ④ one prop, one read.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2`, `documentation` stay.

## ⚠️ Correction to this seat's own facet ③ — the second argument is a CLOSED mode token, and the protocol says so in its own words

`domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-18T12:30Z. Posted before anyone acts on the block I wrote 15 minutes ago: **facet ③ and the options table in the body were wrong in a way that changes the answer**, and the body is being corrected in the same act. The readings below were taken first-hand, ⛔ none is relayed.

### What I missed, and where it is written

| # | reading | where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `{ name: 'onNavigate', type: "(recordId, action: 'view' \| 'edit') => void", kind: 'callback', … }` | `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `origin/main`, `packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts:321` |
| 2 | `view.list.navigation.view` **was removed in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0** (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) | same repo, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1815-1822` |
| 3 | `const view = navigation?.view;` — this repo still READS that key and feeds it to the callback | `objectstack-ai/objectui` `origin/main`, `packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts:275` |
| 4 | `'@objectstack/spec@17.4.0'` — the version this repo actually resolves | this repo's `pnpm-lock.yaml` (ranges are `^17.x`, so the removal is one bump away) |

Reading 2 states the protocol's own position on the very argument this card is about, verbatim:

> the value was passed straight into the navigation-MODE argument of the console's `onNavigate`, where anything other than `edit` or `view` matched no branch, so the key selected nothing and could silently deaden the row click

and, in the file comment beside it: *"an authored name did not select a view, it **SUBSTITUTED** for the mode"*, *"Declared, consumed, and wrong"*.

### What that does to the decision

I wrote in facet ③ that the value set **is not closed**, because an authored `navigation.view` name can appear there. That is true **only on 17.4.0**, and it is true only because this repo is still reading a key the protocol has already removed:

- the second argument is a **navigation-MODE token** with a closed vocabulary — the protocol says so;
- the authored-name path is not a feature of that vocabulary, it is the defect ADR-0049 retired one minor version ago;
- ⇒ once this repo bumps to `@objectstack/spec` ≥ 17.5.0, the emitted set is exactly `'view'` and `'new_window'` — **closed**, and a closed union becomes the honest declaration rather than a false one.

So the protocol's `'view' | 'edit'` is wrong about **one member, not about the shape**: it names `edit`, which no branch sends, and omits `new_window`, which two of the four call sites send (`:314`, `:337`).

### The consequence the maintainer should see

A free `string` (option A) is honest **today** and wrong **after the bump**; a closed union is honest **after the bump** and wrong **today**. ⇒ landing A now and the union later changes one published prop's type **twice**, which is the staged shape the 2026-08-27 ruling refuses (「短期不考虑渐进」). The body's option table and recommendation are corrected accordingly; ⛔ the letters are unchanged in meaning, the sequencing constraint is new.

⛔ Still not this seat's to settle, and ⛔ nothing here re-rules anything: this narrows what the maintainer is choosing between, it does not choose.

### Filed from these readings

- `objectstack-ai/objectstack` — the protocol declares a mode vocabulary its own reference implementation contradicts (`react-blocks.ts:321` vs the four call sites). Dedupe words: `onNavigate react-blocks ListView action union new_window`.
- `objectstack-ai/objectui` — `useNavigationOverlay.ts:275` still consumes `navigation.view`, removed in spec 17.5.0; adjacent to objectui#9667 (the parity-pin half of the same retirement), which is about a TEST pin and ⛔ does not cover this live consumer. Dedupe words: `navigation.view consumer useNavigationOverlay spec 17.5.0 retired`.

⛔ Neither was deduped by this seat — 立卡者不查重、只附查重词;真撞上重复,先比数值与作用域再决定关哪个.
